description: Combine product subtotal, estimated shipping and preliminary duty into a destination landed-cost range. The response includes assumptions and must not be treated as a binding quote.

destination.description: Buyer delivery destination for shipping and duty assumptions.

dimensionsCm.description: Optional packed shipment dimensions in centimeters.

environment.description: Catalog environment. Only production listings are public.

hsCode.description: Optional HS code used for preliminary duty estimation.

items.description: Requested SKU lines used to calculate product subtotal. Every quantity must meet that SKU MOQ and remain within confirmed sellable inventory.

quantity.description: Requested whole units; the server enforces MOQ and inventory.

weightKg.description: Optional packed weight per unit in kilograms.

name: estimate_landed_cost

outputSchema.description: Non-binding landed-cost range with visible assumptions.
